references.provenance: Anime screenshot; archive attributes it to Pop Goes the Sneasel.
references.review: Root visually inspected. Shows upper lid, stationary LCD body, lower controls, bottom lens and open right control flap together. Source screen content remains a private reference, not an asset texture.

references.provenance: Archive identifies The Official Pokémon Handbook 3 artwork; not an episode frame.
references.review: Root visually inspected. Whole upper lid has a circular tongue at its free edge. The control cover swings right and has a semicircular notch along its upper edge. Exact hinge internals remain authored engineering.

references.provenance: Archive identifies The Official Pokémon Handbook 3 artwork; not an episode frame.
references.review: Root visually inspected. Closed cover seam crosses the large central circular motif. Bottom blue lens stays exposed. This supports a split screen-lid/control-flap closure, not a single whole-body lid.

references.provenance: Supplemental game-style illustration from archive; attribution not independently verified as original official artwork.
references.review: Root visually inspected. Shows a stepped cover fitting below the sensor header. Its added D-pad and main round button differ from the Ash anime still; do not import those controls into the Ash model or use this illustration as the primary identity contract.
